identity.name: Map Marker Extensions (MME)
aliases: Treasure Chest X on Xaero's Map
legacy_names: Treasure Chest X on Xaero's Map

goals: Preserve distinct native map-marker identities for Matcha structure maps across vanilla opened maps, carried-map item presentation, and optional compatible map viewers without collapsing formerly shared decoration groups.

Expose possession-gated, ephemeral carried-map targets to Xaero Minimap and Xaero World Map while preserving exact coordinates, dimensions, deduplication, lifecycle, upright orientation, and accepted positive 2x World Map scale.
Normalize only the known plus-sign map decoration to its expected custom holder while preserving coordinates, rotation, every unrelated decoration, and all other ItemStack components.

Recognize explicitly marked externally owned native filled-map identities for possession-gated Xaero projection without registering, rewriting, classlinking, or supplying the external marker or item artwork.
scope: Canonical C12 source for Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric: a single self-contained JAR that bundles the user-confirmed Ribbits-style filled-map item resource chain for all 18 owned products and preserves C11's nearest-neighbor reframed 8-by-8 POI artwork for the 17 custom holders. The immutable corrected input is originals/assets/MME-C11-ribbits-style-inventory-routing.zip (69,803 bytes, SHA-256 5864BF56D06B481E6B037E72C6E6826A54AE2B100CDA6B72615F8AEC72EC9C54); its 17 POIs are byte-identical to C11. No C12 companion MME resource pack exists by design.

The sole 18-row MapMarkerIdentity table, 17 registered map_marker_extension MapDecorationType holders, vanilla minecraft:red_x retention for buried treasure, idempotent map normalization, and immediate MapItemSavedData refresh behavior.

One marker-gated external-native identity for a real minecraft:filled_map with minecraft:map_id and ribbits:ribbit_village_explorer_map=true, admitting only the existing ribbits:ribbit_village holder and passing its ordinary decoration coordinates and live asset through to Xaero.

Optional client-only Xaero integrations, common/server-capable persistent marker identity, 17 bundled opened-map sprites, and 18 bundled filled-map item definitions/models/textures loaded directly from standard Fabric mod resources.

Exact current C12 single JAR map-marker-extension-0.4.0-canary12.jar, with exact C11, C10, C9, and C8 JAR/resource-pack pairs and accepted Treasure X C4 retained separately as provenance and rollback evidence.

exclusions: Xaero Minimap, Xaero World Map, Minecraft map-rendering internals, Compass Ribbon, Matcha, and other icon systems remain separate owners and are not modified or bundled.

Ribbits owns ribbits:ribbit_village registration, marker sprite, filled-map item presentation, success-marker production, and all Ribbits classes and resources; MME holds only inert string identities and reads standard synchronized components.
Marker targeting, atlas ownership, icon normalization, compass integration, rendering geometry, and persistence behavior are migrated unchanged rather than redesigned.
C8 and Treasure X C4 must never be co-loaded; C4 is a retained artifact rollback, not a data-safe world rollback after C7 or C8 has persisted custom holder keys.

Legacy status READMEs, BUILD_PROVENANCE, MATCHA_MAPS_PROJECT, accumulated canary histories, C1-C3/C5-C6 binaries, deployment snapshots, manager state, global trackers, and historical administrative records are not migrated.
Minecraft deployment, Test Slot mutation, accepted physical-stack changes, dedicated Workbench mutation, and protected gameplay-instance access are outside this migration.
